prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, a hint of despair, her eyes softly worried and shining, her brow lightly drawn together, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes. Long almond nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic — a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The paint has worn thin in broad patches over her upper back, hips and calves and chipped off in small flakes at her wrists and ankles, the living skin showing through the faded pattern. Soot smudges her brow, upper lip and cheeks, sweat runs in clean tracks through the grime on her face, black streaks cross her arms and legs, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back and down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall behind her at hip height on its own side. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, back to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor at the base of the wall behind her, all four chains pulled dead taut.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her torso leaning forward against the pull of the chains behind her, her arms drawn back and down along her sides, her shoulders pulled back, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.
